game.q: why might a voice beat a bell or a horn?
opts: bells cost too much to make
a voice can say what you’re called to
you can’t hit snooze on a voice

wrong.cost: a fair guess. but it was about the words.
wrong.snooze: kind of true. but the reason is the words.

game.right: YES. a bell only says now. a voice says what for: come to prayer, come to success.

end.line: they could have picked a bell. a dream gave them words instead.
